name: Soup drop
summary: A bedside tray drawn from above for someone who's sick; friends drop one thing onto it (soup, tea, tissues, a show, a playlist, oranges) with a few words, each lands in a free spot with their face, and the thermometer on the tray creeps down as it fills.
useWhen: day 3 of the flu, send help
got my wisdom teeth out, entertain me
stuck at home with a cold
dontUseWhen: a real errand run with money (use pickup-run)
a small win to celebrate (use win-jar)
serious grief or bad news (no tool, just reply)

temp.description: Temperature now in tenths of a degree (1021 is 102.1); it falls a little with each thing on the tray

tray.description: Things already on the tray: what and their words (for a show or playlist, its name)
